answer: Call it delay-metered leases: identity minting requires solving a randomized verifiable-delay puzzle seeded by an umber beacon; timing receipts cross a public bridge to light clients, which sample a plume of recent work. Honest agents pay only marginal compute they already expend. A clone needs a separate hardware root and independently serialized delay work, so N identities cost ~N× energy/time and earn no shared reward, making sybils economically dominated.
